title: Survey and Survey Providers
content:
As part of our OKR follow-up tasks, one task involved investigating “survey providers”, and how surveys are done at IPEX.

We got response from communication team that https://forms.office.com/Pages/DesignPageV2.aspx is a suitable page to pursue this further.

Reference task on our Jira board is PE-1794, which will now be closed.
